verifications.claim: The March 2026 Producer Price Index (PPI) showed a 0.5% monthly increase.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The producer price index... increased a seasonally adjusted 0.5% for the month" (R1); "The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 0.5 percent in March, seasonally adjusted" (R6); "Producer prices increased less than expected in March... rose 0.5% last month" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the monthly PPI increase as 0.5% for March 2026.

verifications.claim: The March 2026 monthly PPI increased 0.5%, below the estimated 1.1%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "increased a seasonally adjusted 0.5% for the month, well below the Dow Jones consensus estimate for 1.1%" (R1); "PPI rose 0.5%... falling short of analysts' estimate of 1.2%" (R4, close); "forecast the PPI accelerating 1.1%" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm 0.5% monthly increase below 1.1% estimate.

verifications.claim: The March 2026 annual headline PPI rose to 4.0%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "On an annual basis, the all-items PPI accelerated 4%" (R1); "PPI advanced 4.0%... the largest gain since February 2023" (R5); "the index for final demand rose 4.0 percent for the 12 months ended in March" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of 4.0% annual headline PPI.

verifications.claim: The March 2026 annual headline PPI marked the highest gain since February 2023.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the biggest 12-month gain since February 2023" (R1); "the largest gain since February 2023" (R5); "the largest 12-month advance since increasing 4.7 percent in February 2023" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it is the highest since February 2023.

verifications.claim: The March 2026 core PPI (ex-food/energy) increased 0.1% monthly.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Excluding food and energy, core PPI was up just 0.1%" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly matches the core (ex-food/energy) monthly increase of 0.1%.

verifications.claim: The March 2026 core PPI increased 3.8% annually.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Core PPI posted a 3.8% annual gain" (R1); "the PPI ex Food & Energy was up 3.8% YoY" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match for annual core PPI at 3.8%.

verifications.claim: The March 2026 core PPI monthly increase was less than the expected 0.5%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "core PPI was up just 0.1% against the forecast for 0.5%" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: R1 confirms core monthly increase of 0.1% below 0.5% expectation.
